newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: The following is a profile of the winner of the women's slalom at the Alpine skiing world championships on Wednesday:

Previous World Cup wins: 11. Giant slaloms - Zwiesel I+II (97), Cortina (97), Narvik (96), Haus (95), Morzine (94), Veysonnaz (93), Tignes (93), Slalom - Semmering (96), Super-G - Morzine (92), Morzine (93)

Other facts: Twice winner of Olympic gold, giant slalom at the 1994 Lillehammer Winter Games and the super-G at Albertville in 1992. Won giant slalom world championship title last year in Sierra Nevada, Spain. Career disrupted by injuries and illness. Nearly died in 1990 of intestinal blockage while at home recovering from knee operation. After winning gold in Albertville sustained career-threatening knee injury in giant slalom.
